description: This file defines a Unity MonoBehaviour class 'TiltInput' that manages tilt-based input on mobile devices, including mapping tilt angles to virtual axes or mouse positions. It also includes an editor property drawer for customizing the tilt input mappings within the Unity Editor.

classes.name: TiltInput
classes.description: Manages tilt input, converting device accelerometer data into virtual axis or mouse position commands based on configuration.

classes.name: TiltInput.AxisMapping
classes.description: Defines mapping details for the tilt input, including the type of mapping and axis name.

classes.name: TiltInput.AxisOptions
classes.description: Enumeration for the axis around which tilt is measured, either Forward or Sideways.

methods.name: OnEnable
methods.description: Initializes the virtual axis if mapping type is NamedAxis.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Calculates tilt angle based on device accelerometer data and updates virtual axis or mouse position accordingly.

methods.name: OnDisable
methods.description: Removes the virtual axis when the component is disabled.

methods.name: OnGUI
methods.description: Custom property drawer code for presenting the AxisMapping in the Unity Editor.
